subject.title: 5.26 supervisor mode + dual-plist install: 30s EADDRINUSE loop + silent-fail unset order

question: What durable macOS launchd policy should OpenClaw use when gateway and node LaunchAgents both inject OpenClaw launchd labels and the gateway wrapper sources those labels before exec?
rationale: The source-backed failure shape is real enough to keep open, but clearing markers, disabling or preserving the node LaunchAgent, and adding doctor/install repair behavior define supported operator and upgrade semantics.

options.title: Docs-First Plus Runtime Policy
options.body: Land the docs mitigation if maintainers accept the node-service warning, then design a runtime/doctor fix that clears only unsafe inherited markers and preserves intentional node-service setups.

options.title: Runtime Fix Before Public Runbook
options.body: Pause the docs workaround until maintainers decide and implement the generated-wrapper and node-lifecycle behavior so users are not asked to edit wrappers manually.

options.title: Defer To Broader Profile/Launchd Design
options.body: Keep this as part of the wider macOS profile and service-boundary design discussion if the dual-plist loop cannot be separated safely.

recommendation.title: Docs-First Plus Runtime Policy
recommendation.body: Land the docs mitigation if maintainers accept the node-service warning, then design a runtime/doctor fix that clears only unsafe inherited markers and preserves intentional node-service setups.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across node daemon introduction, launchd lifecycle, supervisor-marker extraction, and the product policy around macOS service management.
